# Bhavye Thakkar

> Data Scientist and Flutter Engineer. AI/ML, computer vision and data analytics in Python and TensorFlow; mobile apps in Flutter.

Everything below is public information from this portfolio. It contains no
private contact details and no employment history — the site's Experience
section is written separately and is not summarised here.

Placeholder note: the domain in the links below is the project's configured
placeholder. It is changed here, in index.html, in sitemap.xml and in
robots.txt together.

## About

I craft digital products that merge creativity with technology. With hands-on
experience in Flutter and AI/ML, I've built apps, explored data-driven
solutions, and brought ideas to life at hackathons. What excites me most is
solving real problems with simple, scalable tech — and leaving an impact that
lasts.

Based in India.

## Projects

- [Garba Circle](https://example.com/project/garbacircle) — Navratri & Garba app

Public repositories:

- [Mobile Finance App](https://github.com/bhavye-thakkar/Expense-tracker) — Flutter expense tracking with budget analysis (Flutter, Python, SQLAlchemy)
- [Stock Market Analyzer](https://github.com/bhavye-thakkar/Stock_MArket-prediction-AI-ML) — stock prediction with machine learning (Python, Streamlit, yfinance, scikit-learn)
- [House Price Prediction](https://github.com/bhavye-thakkar/house-price-prediction-with-the-help-of-streeamlit) — regression model behind a Streamlit interface (Python, Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy)

To-Do App (Flutter, Firebase, Dart) has no public repository.

## The room

The portfolio is a 3D workspace. Two objects in it are clickable and open a
short page explaining why they were chosen — design notes, not claims about
the author.

- [The Orchid](https://example.com/object/orchid) — a Phalaenopsis modelled procedurally rather than imported; on patience and slow work
- [The Starry Night](https://example.com/object/starry-night) — Vincent van Gogh, 1889, public domain reproduction; on seeing a familiar pattern differently
